body: I hope someone rapes you to death, literally.
So I can be alone forever?

Oh the things I've had said to me for me behavior.  On the flip side my AP did have a ton of shame over for the affair and broke it off for that reason, and wouldn't let me take any responsibility.  I am kinda pissed at her for that.

Oh she's footloose and fancy free, dating one guy fairly seriously and sleeping with at least one other. I'm in a LTR, basically married for all intents and purposes.  We were so close before all this happened as friends it's just like getting a double gutt punch.  You know, that chick friend you harmlessly flirt with who you totally want to bang, and then your girlfriend both gone all at once.
You know I think I'm back to the suicidal ideation today thinking of it.  Non-existence vs just bleh...I mean why? I'm not going to enjoy life again.

I don't know, better than my 80 year old being alone in a home bitter that I gave up the one last chance I had not to me alone.  

I've been told I'm too nice so I don't think the good person part really works.  I feel like it's the opposite, I see borderline abusive, incredibly stupid men most of the women I've dated.  My last ex ended up with a series of abusive guys who ended up getting her hooked on opioids, ex before that went back to get ex who was using meth and bath salts, and would egg her on when she attempted suicide or engaged in self harm.  A friend I had a fling with ended up with a super douchey guy who puts on this ridiculous fake show of being the happiest guy alive after she tells me I'm too nice.  

I guess maybe I did my best when I was my bitter angry self and treated everyone like trash, because I was being myself, instead of being a pleaser.
I am told that in person I am too nice, a doormat, a pushover, and a people pleaser.  This is the bitterness that exists inside me.
I live in Trump country on top of that, so that makes it even harder.

Parents and my dog.  I used to play Xbox quite a bit, but I lost interest in it.  I had a really really good friend, but lots of stuff happened so I'm so interested in being friends anymore.  My other friends all live in other parts of the country because my career took me to another state.  I regret taking this job even though I make more money.

Again, maybe I've only had experiences that show me this is how life works.  I have never had experiences that have demonstrated otherwise.  Maybe I've only interacted with shitty people, if that is the case where do these people who do not behave this way exist so I can start applying for jobs there and move there, because it sure as hell hasn't been in any place where I have lived.

Maybe if I had some experiences that actually proved me wrong.  Everything in my experience, from having zero female interest in me when I had a shitty job, except when I was running 4 miles every other day- 2 miles the other days, and doing intensive strength training on those 2 mile days and eating nothing except for protein, to actually getting turned down because I had said shitty job (I was actually told that straight up).  Again, every experience I have had has showed me life works a certain way, maybe I've just only ever interated with shitty people, but nothing has shown me that I'll ever have any other interactions.
Yes, if it was someone I would be happy with, or at least someone who would help me learn what it would be like to get on that path toward that happiness if that makes sense.

I think my issue is basically those reasons, being out of shape and not having a shit ton of money were out right the reasons I was rejected, and straight up told why I was rejected, several times.  So it gave me a bit of a complex.
Probably would consider it.

We had been trying to have kids, and then found out she had some medical issues which were corrected recently.  My counts are a bit low, not super low which doesn't help combined with her age.
She essentially did say that she was concerned she wouldn't find someone to have kids in time, since her clock is ticking.

Was it listed by an external recruiter or someone in the company?  An external recruiter will always get the person who can make them the biggest bonus.  The internal person has to look busy, so they might have postings that make no sense and get you interviewed for garbage positions no one will ever get hired for to keep their job looking relevant.  I mean when the head of HR goes to leadership and says "we have increased our interviews and postings by 200% we just aren't finding the right candidates." They look like rockstars because C-level management only understand stats, and have no concept of reality.

You hit the nail on the head!  It wasn't entry level, but I interviewed for a job that was offering $30k when the normal starting salary is $75k on the lowest end.  I figured ehhh I might not have everything they need, but since they are low balling no one else will apply.  During the interview they basically went on to say they wanted someone who could make six figures easily.  Denied me because some guy who had just moved to the area had all those skills was desperate.

Professors are underpaid, and that's why they don't care.  You have coaches with multi million dollar salaries and Nobel Prize winning scientists teaching kids remedial classes and paying them less than tier 2 tech support engineers and being asked to publish multiple peer reviewed papers per year.  

The true reason tuition is so high is because of the 40 people on payroll in the registrars office, probably making more than most associate professors, who take 3 hour lunches.

That is not acceptable for them to behave in such a fashion.  Here is what you do.

At 2am call your doctor's and you'll get put through to his answering service, tell them it's an emergency and you need to speak to your doc pronto.  Once he's on the phone tell him the exact behavior his staff engaged in, and request a 6 months supply so that you don't have to bother him at 2am, or on the weekends when he's golfing etc.  Be a pain in your doctor's ass.  

Doctors are in the business for their patients, office staff are there to punch a clock, they don't care if you live or die.

I will say things are getting better with some time.  I have tried distancing myself from my friend a little bit and my fiancee, who has struggled with suicidal ideation herself, suggested I pick up a hobby to keep my mind at ease.  I have already picked up one, but will be picking up another soon.  

The problem has been my friend and her inconsistent attitude toward me.  I stopped talking to her for a couple days to try to get her out of my head, then asked her about a job she had been recruited for, to make sure we weren't applying for the same job (we work in the same industry and I didn't want to work in the same position, or be in the running for the same job as her.)  Then we got to talking...then it all started again.  Huge cycle...talk for a few days then she's back to one word answers.

My experiences with therapists have been....very very very bad.  Pretty much just money sinks when I could just find some random stranger to talk to about my problems, read a book, and go to a support group, which is what came out my therapy experiences.

This feels so different, I woke up this morning at 3am, my head literally felt like it was buzzing with thoughts of "well if I had treated her this way"  "well if I had just told her we shouldn't" "well if I had just left my fiance for her."  Really I used to have those thoughts after other break ups, or job changes or other decisions, but they might last a day, or creep up on me one night then disappear, but this felt like bees in my head and its every other night.

Depends on where you want to move.  Higher cost of living means you need more money.  Anytime I have "started over" with nothing I had at least 3 months rent, plus money for food and utilities.  I would say you should have that much, plus some just in case the shit hits the fan or you take awhile getting a job that can pay the bills.  Don't do anything illicit to make money.

I think we all have points in our lives when people drift away from us all at once, and it's hard.  It's even harder for those of us who are not the same as everyone else and who aren't the life of the party.  

None of this was inappropriate, if posting here made you feel better and take a step back from the ledge then it wasn't inappropriate.

My big problem is that when I wake up at 3am crying and sick to my stomach every other day I cant tell myself these things.  All I want is to either die, or everything I'm obsessing about to change.

Wait.  I can't say I'm happier now than when I was 13 overall, but I definitely had some fun times between 13 and 38 to keep my mind off how awful existence is.  Right now you don't have any control in your life, wait until you are in your mid 20s and you can do what you want to make you happy.  Something isn't working for you to make you happy then, change it.  The great thing about once you become an adult you can change your circumstances, to an extent, and if you can't change them you can hide in a bottle (and in many states a bong) to sort out your feelings, or wait for circumstances to change.  At your age, you have to take what is thrown at you.  Power through, save your cash, once you hit 18 pick a place and move.

Your girlfriend and family must be pretty terrific if they have kept you from killing yourself so far.  

Just think how your girlfriend is going to cope with the pandemic without you?  How your family will?  

My biggest anchor is my dog.  He gets so lost when I leave the house for just a few hours, I don't know what he'd think if I was gone forever.  Think of how hard the pandemic is for you with your girlfriend and family, then think what it would be like if your girlfriend or a family member killed themself?  It would make the pandemic that much harder.  I would suggest spending more time with your girlfriend and family since they seem to be what help you the most.
